text: #css tip: use clamp() for fluid typography instead of media-query breakpoints. font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
If your #webdev site still ships unused CSS, run PurgeCSS in your build step. Cut our bundle by 60%.
#frontend devs: container queries are production-ready now. Stop reaching for JS to handle component-level responsiveness.
#css grid + subgrid finally has full browser support. Rebuild your card layouts, you'll delete half your markup.
#frontend performance win: swap your web fonts to font-display: swap and preload the critical weight only.
